summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term, ultra-LEAPS bullish bets on the S&P 500, evidenced by massive $1.45B in SPX 7000C (2031) and $1.15B in SPX 8000C (2031) accumulations. While QQQ and GLD show aggressive short-term bearishness (P/C of 2.73 and 13.25, respectively), the dominant conviction lies in the persistent, multi-day accumulation of SPX 7000C strikes expiring in 2026 and 2027, totaling billions in premium. Traders should watch for a divergence between short-term volatility in tech (QQQ/MU) and the massive, structural long-term floor being built in SPX via the 7000 and 8000 strike levels.
